baseline: IU1-0040 Rev1.0 User Guide + IE1-0040 Rev1.1 Engineer Manual, combined original manufacturer booklet. Accenta G4 LCD baseline; no G3 or built-in Optima compact LED menu substitution.

source.title: Accenta/Optima User Guide and Accenta G4 Engineer’s Manual
source.pageNumbering: User: PDF 1–24, printed Arabic page +4. Engineer: PDF 25–80, printed Arabic page +28.
source.scope: Original manufacturer booklet in a third-party archive. Accenta G4 with 8EP417A LCD keypad; the LED/Optima compact variations are distinguished. Revision footers are on PDF24 and PDF80.

notUsedAsImplementationBaseline.reason: Older revision; retained as corroboration only, not mixed into the selected Rev1.1 implementation.

sourceConflicts.title: Flag2 SET wording conflict
sourceConflicts.question: Does SET save, toggle, or depend on selection stage in Flag2 on this firmware?
sourceConflicts.reason: Engineer p23 first says digits or SET toggle, then explicitly says SET saves and RESET leaves; the same page diagram and p21 also use SET to save. The emulator follows the repeated save instruction and uses digits to toggle.
sourceConflicts.neededEvidence: A source-matched keypad recording of Flag2 selection, SET and RESET.

sourceConflicts.title: Physical keypad comparison
sourceConflicts.question: Can an 8EP417A on Accenta G4 be checked against these specific manual revisions?
sourceConflicts.reason: The menu tree is pinned to original printed sources; LCD spacing, key-repeat, beeps and firmware variation have not been measured on hardware.
sourceConflicts.neededEvidence: A consented video of the relevant menu operations with panel and software version visible.

sourceConflicts.title: Omission arrow behaviour
sourceConflicts.question: Does ▲ only browse, or also omit, in the LCD user omission screen?
sourceConflicts.reason: User p6 says zone number or up arrow to be omitted, without a clear separate browse/toggle description. The emulator uses digits to omit and ▲ to browse, and never asserts repeated-digit reinstatement.
sourceConflicts.neededEvidence: A short keypad recording showing ▲ and repeating the same zone digit during omission.

sourceConflicts.title: Bell time zero conflict
sourceConflicts.question: Does 00 mean continuous on this precise revision?
sourceConflicts.reason: Engineer p25 gives 01–99 minutes; summary p52 gives 00–99 and specifications p46 mention continuous, without explicitly assigning 00. The editable range is conservatively 01–99.
sourceConflicts.neededEvidence: Manufacturer clarification or G4 firmware-specific keypad evidence for 00.

sourceConflicts.title: Exit-time diagram typo
sourceConflicts.question: Confirm menu5 for exit time on hardware.
sourceConflicts.reason: Engineer p39 LCD prose, p34 structure and p52 summary identify Exit Time as5; a p39 diagram/LED instruction wrongly repeats4. The emulator follows the mutually corroborated LCD route5.

sourceConflicts.title: Duress permission conflict
sourceConflicts.question: Confirm user1 cannot program duress in this baseline.
sourceConflicts.reason: Engineer p28 introductory text is inconsistent with User Guide p13, which explicitly restricts duress setup/edit/delete to engineer programming. The user roots follow the restrictive, explicit user-guide rule.
sourceConflicts.neededEvidence: Hardware permission check or corrected manufacturer manual.

sourceConflicts.title: Omit-allow default conflict
sourceConflicts.question: Which factory omission eligibility applies to the actual firmware?
sourceConflicts.reason: Engineer p31 says all zones enabled as Omit Allow; the LED notes on p33 say default off. No factory-default claim is made; all initial settings are labelled FINDR fixtures.
sourceConflicts.neededEvidence: Corrected manufacturer defaults table or firmware-specific record.

sourceConflicts.title: Physical and signalling effects
sourceConflicts.question: Which physical demonstrations would you like verified next?
sourceConflicts.reason: No live bell, communicator, PA, tamper, timed rearm, entry countdown or ARC is connected. LEDs, sounds and generated events are illustrative local feedback.
sourceConflicts.neededEvidence: Controlled hardware comparison for the exact system variant.

verification.notes: Every factual map node has an exact combined-PDF page reference. All application values and events are fictional. Runtime tests are recorded in the family test file.
